verdict.rationale: GitHub documents official REST and GraphQL APIs plus authentication mechanisms (fine-grained PATs, permissions) that developers can build against, and provides a CLI and MCP server for programmatic access, but the evidence pack never names or links an official SDK (e.g., Octokit) for any language, nor SDK-specific docs, versioning, or install instructions. missing for 10: explicit official SDK libraries, language-specific package docs/installation, and SDK versioning/support guarantees.
